title: Warp Edge Cases and Robustness
description: Implement and verify the edge cases and robustness requirements for the inter-system warp flow, ensuring stability under error conditions and full occupancy.
acceptanceCriteria: Cancel/edge: Warp cannot be started twice; the warp button is disabled during the transition period
Occupancy: Warping into a full system (16 players) is aborted; server rejects the warp, and the client rolls back the warp overlay and shows a 'System full' toast
Robustness: Disconnecting mid-warp leaves no ghost entities in either the source or target shards (verified via WS integration tests of shard entity counts)
e2e (TASK-70): All warp flow tests, including rejection and edge cases, pass in the e2e suite (npm run test:e2e)

steps.details: Ensure the warp button in the star chart is disabled while the warp state machine is in 'warping-in', 'awaiting', or 'warping-out' states.

Update server warp handler to reject warp if target shard is full (16 players), sending {code: 'system-full'}. Update client to handle this response by rolling back the warp overlay and triggering a toast notification.
Ensure that if a connection is lost during the warp transition, the entity is correctly removed from the source shard and not left as a 'ghost' in the target shard.
Run WS integration tests for shard occupancy and disconnects, and run the full e2e suite (npm run test:e2e) to verify all warp-related criteria are met.

technicalNotes: Builds upon the fixed happy path from TASK-8.1.
Verification of ghost entities requires checking shard entity lists on the server side during integration tests.
